name: Nordicus Partners Corporation
summary: Nordicus Partners Corporation functions as a publicly traded entity that acts as both a business accelerator and a holding company, specifically supporting Nordic life sciences firms operating within the United States. A central focus for the company involves advancing oral healthcare through the development of new medicines. In addition to its core operations, Nordicus offers an array of corporate finance and advisory services. These include aiding in business and market expansion, formulating strategic growth plans, identifying and acquiring talent, fostering key partnerships, facilitating capital raising efforts, and orchestrating company acquisitions or sales. The organization, which was established in 1993 and is headquartered in Beverly Hills, California, rebranded as Nordicus Partners Corporation in May 2023, having previously been known as EKIMAS Corporation.
